title: PredictionWriterOutput
description: Falsifiable prediction about a Solana DAO proposal's vote outcome, grounded in a governance-triage JSON. Committable to the reputation program's submit_prediction instruction.

predicted_outcome.description: Index 0..num_choices-1. Caller enforces the num_choices upper bound before submitting on-chain; schema allows up to 7 to match the reputation program's u8 / [u16; 8] cap.

confidence_bps.description: Self-reported confidence, basis points. Hard Rule #2 in SKILL.md caps this by triage.confidence.overall: low→≤6000, medium→≤8000, high→≤9500.

reasoning_citation.description: 1-4 sentence justification grounded in triage fields. Not boilerplate. No recommendation language.

key_triage_signals.description: References to specific triage fields that drove the prediction. Format '<field_path>:<value>' (e.g. 'red_flag:backdoor_permission:high').
